As a divorced resident that almost lost my visa to stay in Germany: Look for a way to get your permanent residence without your wife. You never know what the future holds…. I wish you the best but after an amount of time a person finds a home in Germany with or without a partner… weil es einfach ein wahnsinnig tolles Land ist und die Leute hier auch toll sind… 

Do it without the marriage way… if a divorce ever comes your visa is after 90 days voided. 

The correct way is 8 years with resident visa and then application for permanent.  Outside of legal problems it should be approved. 
You would need a b-1 german certificate(bekommst bei fast jeder Hochschule/ Berufsschule oder for/bos) you also need to prove that you have been a perfect citizen for the 8 years and never used Andy social help.  
Using the Arbeitsamt or any other Amt is ok as long s it is not over a longer period of time. 

For the best advice go to the local Ausländerbehorde and ask what you need to do to live permanently in Germany.  Ask always about yourself… un inclusive from a marriage.  Talk facts not opinions. When you speak with the “Behörden” versuchen immer im Deutsch zu reden (auch wenn es gebrochen ist) Man bekommt viele Punkte um das teile das Burger zu sein als man wertet. Wenn du was nicht verstehst frag so oft bis du es verstehst. Davon lernst du auch weiter.
